2027 Graduate Civil / Traffic Engineer
 Engineering & Design 
 Melbourne 
 Permanent / Full Time 
 17/9/2026 
Supportive team
Strong career growth and mentoring
Southbank office
About us:
 WGA, an AtkinsRéalis Company, is a multidisciplinary engineering and project management consultancy delivering complex infrastructure projects across Australia and New Zealand. Combining deep local knowledge with global capability, we connect our clients to an extensive network of engineering specialists, innovative solutions, and industry-leading expertise across the transportation, water, power and renewables, ports and marine, defence, resources, and industrial sectors. 
 With a team of over 800 people, WGA provides a rich, diverse, and empowered workplace and offers you a chance to work alongside some of the best in the business. We offer a collaborative work environment that promotes mutual learning, respect, dignity, cultural openness, and an appreciation for diverse perspectives and backgrounds. 
 At WGA, you'll find inspiring career pathways, opportunities to learn from technical specialists, and the support to grow professionally and personally. We offer a range of employee benefits, including industry-leading parental leave, flexible working arrangements, work-from-home opportunities, and learning and development programs designed to help you succeed. 
About our approach:
 We focus on the core philosophy of delivering excellent engineering solutions for our valued clients, which allows us to create exceptional, long-term opportunities for our personnel. Our unique style of project delivery ensures that our people don't have to choose between maintaining hands-on engineering design and corporate career options, they can have both! 
About our Role:
 Due to exciting growth across our VIC/TAS region, WGA is seeking Graduate Civil and Traffic Engineers to join our Melbourne team.
 This is a fantastic opportunity to kick-start your engineering career with a growing, people-focused consultancy. You'll contribute to meaningful projects, learn from experienced industry professionals, and develop your technical and professional skills during an exciting period of growth and transformation. 
 In partnership with industry leaders, WGA has developed an inclusive and engaging Graduate Program designed to support your transition from study to professional practice. We are interested in hearing from recent graduates and final-year students who are passionate about building a rewarding career in engineering. 
 This position will commence in February 2027. 
About you:
You will: 
Have recently graduated, or be in your final year of study, in Civil Engineering, Transport / Traffic Engineering or related disciplines. 
Bring a positive attitude, curiosity, and a genuine eagerness to learn.  
Thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and team-oriented environment. 
Demonstrate strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities effectively. 
Possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, enabling you to build strong relationships with colleagues, clients, and industry stakeholders. 
Be motivated to contribute, grow professionally, and make a positive impact on the communities we serve. 
About working with us:
 At WGA, we believe a diverse workplace fosters unique and progressive ideas and drives our culture of learning and knowledge sharing. We welcome applications from all candidates from all backgrounds. Join us and advance your career while enjoying the unique benefits and opportunities that come with being part of a local team with global reach. 
 WGA is a Work180 endorsed workplace for women, find out more at WGA | WORK180 Endorsed Employer

Title:
Cadet Drafter
Are you looking to kick start your career with a global engineering consultancy?
Join us today!
We are renowned for working in partnership with our clients and construction partners to deliver exceptional outcomes based on our collaborative approach and our “One Team” value. 
In Australia, KBR employ nearly 1000 people with offices in each state. Our project delivery track record, industry profile and strong relationships have enabled us to grow significantly, and we continue to expand. This continued growth allows us to offer unrivalled opportunities to our staff in terms of career paths, career development and project exposure.
Creating a superb culture is also huge for us and a key part of our success and growth. Genuine collaboration across the business is integral to how we work. As a company KBR have created an open, inclusive organisation where people matter, are valued, and cared about. By joining KBR you can be assured that you are joining a team that pulls in the same direction and shares common values.
The Opportunity
To help support recent project wins, we are looking for a cadet drafter to join the team in Melbourne. You will be supported and mentored by a fantastic team and work alongside industry specialists. The role will involve setting up drawings and basic 3D models using CAD software, extracting information from engineering specifications, standards and supplier literature to apply to drafting tasks as well as general support for senior designers and engineers. 
You will work in multidisciplinary teams which will enable you to develop a good understanding of the engineering workflow process. This is predominantly an office based role however you may undertake some site visits to assist with field data acquisition (photos, laser scanning and measurements).
Who are you?
We are looking for someone with a genuine interest in practical applications of technology in society who is a good team player also with the ability to work effectively independently. Vocational training via TAFE or other tertiary institutions (Cert IV or Diploma level in Building/Engineering Design and Drafting or similar). Training to introductory level in a 3D CAD software application like AutoCAD, Civil 3D, 12d, Revit, Microstation
Who We Are
We are committed to social and environmental sustainability and delivering projects with a digital mindset that drives innovation within our business, for our customers and stakeholders.  
Our people blend seamlessly into customer teams to help create a positive impact on the communities and environments they seek to improve. Our expertise and adaptability is unmatched and continues to meet the demands of tomorrow to help shape Australia’s future for the better. 
In addition to working on some fantastic projects, KBR offer an array of benefits focused on providing our people with a great working environment, continual career development, Family friendly flexible work arrangements and work/life balance. Our culture, and our genuine focus on our people is a major factor in our success and we want you to be part of our journey. 
Help shape tomorrow by applying today!
Don’t miss out on this opportunity to leave your impact on our society with one of Australia’s leading infrastructure businesses. Apply now and follow us on LinkedIn to stay up to date with all the latest news and job opportunities.
